A new entrant to the decentralized finance and tokenization space is RWAI, an AI-powered platform designed to streamline the tokenization of Real-World Assets (RWAs) with Web3 project launches, is being introduced to the market.

Using a series of agents rolled out in phases, RWAI seeks to support investors, launchpads, venture capitalists, and project owners, strengthening their decision-making processes and simplifying the launch workflow.

## RWAI Agents: The Power of AI for Tokenization

The RWAI platform will be launched in several phases, each introducing new capabilities and functionalities. The first phase will feature the Launch Researcher Agent, which is designed to provide investors with data and market insights to identify promising crypto projects.
